falling_block.note: Donut Block represents the falling-block mechanic.

crate.note: Native used/throw block represents the pushable crate; no native NSMBU crate was found.

pendulum_ball.note: Chained Chain Chomp ball represents a wrecking ball; chain_link is provided separately.

elevator.note: Native lift segment reused for the elevator.

rotating_platform.note: Native seesaw deck reused for the rotator.

chain_bridge.note: Native rope bridge plank segment; chain_link is supplied for the constraint chain.

slime.note: Native Note Block is the visual substitute for high-friction slime; physics stays slime.

luigi.note: Luigi colour variant of the big Mario capture; native Luigi walk is separately supplied as luigi_native_walk.

luigi_native_walk.note: Native Luigi walk capture only; additional authentic Luigi poses were not available.
